content.title: How to watch Illinois vs. Iowa basketball on TV, live stream
content.text: Andrej Stojakovic #2 of the Illinois Fighting Illini drives to the basket against Denis Badalau #27 of the Rutgers Scarlet Knights during the first half at State Farm Center on Jan. 8, 2026, in Champaign, Illinois.Justin Casterline/Getty ImagesThe Illinois Fighting Illini and Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball teams are scheduled to meet in a Big Ten Conference contest at Carver-Hawkeye Arena in Iowa City, Iowa, on Sunday, Jan. 11. The game is scheduled to start at 11 a.m. CT. Article continues below this adIllinois, ranked No. 16 in The Associated Press poll, enters the matchup 12-3 overall and 3-1 in the Big Ten. Most recently, Illinois defeated Rutgers 81-55 on Thursday. Against Rutgers, Illinois guard Keaton Wagler led the team with 17 points, seven rebounds, and three assists. The No. 19-ranked Iowa Hawkeyes come into the contest 12-3 overall and 2-2 in the Big Ten. On Tuesday, Minnesota beat Iowa 70-67. Facing Minnesota, Iowa guard Bennett Stirtz led the team with 21 points and two assists. How to watch Illinois vs. Iowa basketball on TV, live stream Head coach Brad Underwood of the Illinois Fighting Illini reacts during the second half against the Rutgers Scarlet Knights at State Farm Center on Jan. 8, 2026, in Champaign, Illinois.Justin Casterline/Getty ImagesGame time:11 a.m. CT on Sunday, Jan. 11Article continues below this adTV channel: FOX FOX broadcasters are scheduled to be Jason Benetti (play-by-play) and Steve Smith (analyst). Online live stream: FOXsports.com/live Article continues below this adOnline radio broadcast:Varsity Network app and TheVarsityNetwork.comTerrestrial radio broadcast: WDWS-AM 1400 (Champaign, Illinois); WHMS-FM 97.5 (Champaign, Illinois); KFNS-AM 590 (St. Louis); WBGZ-AM 1570 (Alton, Illinois); WBGZ-FM 94.3 (Alton, Illinois)Brad Underwood is the Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball head coach. Ben McCollum is the Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball head coach.
